DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION

FEDERAL AVIATION ADMINISTRATION

INFORMATION REGARDING CIVIL AERONAUTICS SUBJECT: 5, 6,

1 PURPOSE. This circular is to advise the public that such policy information as is contained in Civil Aeronautics Manuals (CAMS) 1, 3, 5, 6, 7, 9, and may be used in conjunction with specific sections of the Federal Aviation Regulations which correspond with the sections of the Civil Air Regulations to which the policies are applicable, upon recodification effective February CAM 8 may be used in conjunction with FAR FAR and FAR for restricted category certification of small agricultural airplanes only. 2 CANCELLATION. AC No. dated is cancelled. The reference to CAM 8 has been reinstated for small agricultural airplanes. . a. Civil Aeronautics Manual policies provide detailed technical information on acceptable methods of complying with the Such policies are for the guidance of the public and are not mandatory. b . covering the certification of products should not be discarded by interested persons upon recodification, because the rules contained therein, and accompanying policies, will continue to apply to products which have been certificated thereunder. CO Policies applicable to sections of the Federal Aviation Regulations will be contained in the future Advisory Circular issuances, which update and replace the CAM materials.
